create_camera_from_data: create a Camera object from camera data dict and an optional Aria camera model
create_camera_data_dict: create a camera data dictionary from a device row, name, camera model, and device row key
project_world_to_image: project a 3D world point to 2D image coordinates using a Camera object extrinsics
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a 4-element quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix using COLMAP convention
load_aria_camera_models: load Aria device camera calibration models for slam-left, slam-right, and rgb cameras from a VRS path
